title: Video Shoots and Production in Los Angeles
metaTitle: Video Shoots and Production in Los Angeles | TDM
metaDescription: Video shoots for Los Angeles brands: concept and scripts by TDM, filming by our US-based team, editing and post-production at our Lahore operations office.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) plans, scripts and films video shoots for Los Angeles brands and delivers finished brand films, product videos and ad footage. Our US-based team runs the shoot, at your premises or wherever suits the project, and the footage is edited at our operations office in Lahore. You approve the treatment and script before the day and review the cuts online afterwards. Because the people who plan the shoot also film it and brief the editors, nothing is lost between the script and the final cut.

sections.heading: Filming in the film capital
paragraphs: Los Angeles has more production experience per block than anywhere else, and the systems around filming reflect that. Permits for the City of Los Angeles and for unincorporated parts of the county are coordinated through FilmLA. Separate cities inside the region, including Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Burbank and Pasadena, run their own permit processes with their own rules. A shoot that crosses a city line can need two sets of paperwork.

The light is famous and mostly reliable, with some local habits. Along the coast, late spring and early summer mornings are often grey under the marine layer, and the sun may not break through until midday. Autumn can bring hot, dry Santa Ana winds.
Then there is traffic. Moving a shoot from Venice to the Arts District downtown can consume the best hours of light, so a sensible schedule keeps each day within one part of the city.

sections.heading: How TDM runs a production
paragraphs: We start from where the video will be used. Because TDM also runs ads, social media and SEO, the shot list is written backwards from the placements: the openings an ad account needs to test, the demonstrations a product page is missing, the short clips a social calendar will use. You approve the treatment and script first. Casting, locations, props, wardrobe and the schedule are then fixed, our team in the United States films against that plan, and the footage goes to our editors in Lahore.
bullets: Concept, treatment and scripts written for your approval before anything is booked.
A shot-by-shot schedule built around one area of the city per day.
Permit and location needs identified early, by jurisdiction.
Post-production by the team that planned the shoot: ad cuts, reels, product videos and masters.

sections.heading: Does your video need Los Angeles in it?
paragraphs: For a restaurant in Koreatown, a boutique hotel, a showroom on Melrose or a gym in the Valley, the place is the product and it has to be filmed there. For a serum, a supplement, a candle or a piece of consumer tech, the location matters far less than lighting, detail and a clear demonstration. In those cases our team in the United States films on a simple set built for the product, which avoids permits and travel across the city and puts the whole day into the shots themselves.

sections.heading: What to agree before a date is set
paragraphs: Be clear on what the finished videos are for and how many you will receive, in which lengths and formats. Confirm who obtains permits, location agreements and releases from people on camera. Check whether editing is included or whether you will be handed raw files. All of this is written into our plan before production begins.

faqs.q: Who films a TDM shoot for a Los Angeles brand?
faqs.a: Our own US-based team. They run the shoot at your location or wherever the project calls for, and editing is done at our operations office in Lahore. We do not operate a studio in Los Angeles.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to film a commercial video in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: Commercial filming on public property generally needs a permit. FilmLA coordinates permits for the City of Los Angeles and unincorporated county areas, while cities such as Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Burbank and Pasadena have their own processes. We check what applies in pre-production.

faqs.q: How much does a video shoot cost in Los Angeles?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the number of locations, shoot days, people on camera and finished videos. We quote after a free consultation, once the purpose and the shot list are clear.

faqs.q: When is the light best for filming in LA?
faqs.a: Conditions are good for most of the year. Coastal mornings in late spring and early summer are often overcast, so beach scenes are better scheduled later in the day, and inland heat in summer favours early starts.
